tools.name: store_ai_visibility
tools.description: What 7BE knows about how AI assistants see an online store, by domain: how often ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode name it in its categories, its AI Health score and the site problems behind it, and the result of its latest free 7BE store check when one exists. Free; reads only published data.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Find online stores in 7BE's catalog, ordered by how often ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode named them when shoppers asked for products in their category. Filter by category slug (see list_store_categories), a word in the store name or domain, and platform.

tools.name: list_store_categories
tools.description: List the product categories in 7BE's catalog of online stores ranked by how often AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode) recommend them. Use a category slug with find_stores.

tools.name: about_7be
tools.description: What 7BE is, its price (10% of each order an AI assistant sends a store, no subscription), how AI orders are counted, platforms and key pages. The same facts as 7be.io/llms.txt.
